description: This file defines a singleton object 'AppRepositories' providing access to repositories, specifically 'CartRepository'. It manages repository instances with lazy initialization and exposes a function to get item count as a Flow.

classes.name: AppRepositories
classes.description: A singleton object providing access to repositories such as CartRepository, managing their lifecycle and access points.

methods.name: cart
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CartRepository, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: cartItemCount
methods.description: Provides a Flow representing the total quantity of all items in the cart.
